svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Landing (Bin Wall)
svg.desc: Landing page first viewport: one-line promise, a bin wall with one bin lifted toward a best location, and the six-step flow as bin labels.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads the Locations, Inventory and
Transactions files your spare-parts warehouse already exports,
and recommends which parts to move where, with the reason in numbers.
The tool suggests. The planner decides.
The demo runs on synthetic data: 9 aisles, 2,000 locations, 1,545 parts.
Data as of 2026-09-30. No account, no AI at runtime, and the import is never changed.
From export to paper, in the order you work
Every step names its numbers, so you can check the tool before you trust it.
name the file, row and column.
You choose: a whole aisle, a
Run in rounds by rule 1, 2 and
Per aisle: what moves in and
Printed in round order, with a
Honest about the data: the data-as-of date is always shown. Walk Path orders the list; it is not a distance. No capacity checks, no live stock, no metres-saved claims.
